description_en: Queries the details of a WAF instance under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下WAF实例的详情
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-instance-info --instance-id waf-cn-tl32ast0000 --resource-group-id rg-atstuj3rtop0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance that you want to query.

If you do not set this parameter, the information about all WAF instances in the Chinese mainland or outside the Chinese mainland is returned
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的WAF实例的ID。

不设置该参数表示查询中国内地地域或非中国内地地域的所有WAF实例信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. If you do not set this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh: WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

InstanceInfo.description_en: The details of the WAF instance

EndDate.description_en:
The expiration time of the WAF instance. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This parameter is not returned if PayType is 0 (WAF instance is not activated)
EndDate.description_zh:
WAF实例的到期时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。

PayType为0（表示未开通WAF实例）时，不返回该参数

InDebt.description_en:
Indicates whether the WAF instance has an overdue payment. Valid values:

0: The instance has an overdue payment.
1: The instance does not have an overdue payment.

This parameter is not returned if PayType is 0 (WAF instance is not activated)
InDebt.description_zh:
WAF实例是否存在欠费。取值：

0：表示已欠费。
1：表示未欠费。

PayType为0（表示未开通WAF实例）时，不返回该参数

InstanceId.description_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

This parameter is not returned if PayType is 0 (WAF instance is not activated)
InstanceId.description_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

PayType为0（表示未开通WAF实例）时，不返回该参数

PayType.description_en:
The activation status of the WAF instance. Valid values:

0: No WAF instance is activated under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: A subscription instance of WAF is activated under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
<props="china">- 2: A WAF instance that uses the pay-as-you-go billing method is activated under the current Alibaba Cloud account.</props>
PayType.description_zh:
WAF实例的开通状态。取值：

0：表示当前阿里云账号未开通WAF实例。
1：表示当前阿里云账号已开通WAF包年包月实例。
<props="china">- 2：表示当前阿里云账号已开通WAF按量计费实例。</props>

Region.description_en:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

cn: the Chinese mainland.
cn-hongkong: outside the Chinese mainland.

This parameter is not returned if PayType is 0 (WAF instance is not activated)
Region.description_zh:
WAF实例的地域。取值：

cn：表示中国内地。
cn-hongkong：表示非中国内地。

PayType为0（表示未开通WAF实例）时，不返回该参数

RemainDay.description_en:
The remaining available days of the trial WAF instance.

This parameter is returned only if Trial is 1 (a trial WAF instance is activated)
RemainDay.description_zh:
试用版WAF实例的剩余可用天数。

只有当Trial为1（表示已开通试用版WAF实例）时，才返回该参数

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the WAF instance has expired. Valid values:
0: expired.
1: not expired.

This parameter is not returned if PayType is 0 (WAF instance is not activated)
Status.description_zh:
WAF实例是否过期。取值：
0：表示已过期。
1：表示未过期。

PayType为0（表示未开通WAF实例）时，不返回该参数

SubscriptionType.description_en:
<props="china">The billable method of the WAF instance. Valid values:</props>
<props="china">- Subscription: subscription.</props>
<props="china">- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go billing method.</props>

<props="intl">The billable method of the WAF instance. The value is fixed as Subscription, which indicates subscription.</props>

This parameter is not returned if PayType is 0 (WAF instance is not activated)
SubscriptionType.description_zh:
<props="china">WAF实例的计费方式。取值：</props>
<props="china">- Subscription：表示包年包月。</props>
<props="china">- PayAsYouGo：表示按量计费。</props>

<props="intl">WAF实例的计费方式。取值固定为Subscription，表示包年包月。</props>

PayType为0（表示未开通WAF实例）时，不返回该参数

Trial.description_en:
Indicates whether a trial WAF instance is activated under the current Alibaba Cloud account. Valid values:

0: No.
1: Yes.

This parameter is returned only if a trial WAF instance is activated under the current Alibaba Cloud account
Trial.description_zh:
当前阿里云账号是否开通了试用版WAF实例。取值：

0：表示否。
1：表示是。

只有当前阿里云账号已开通试用版WAF实例时，才会返回该参数。

Version.description_en:
The edition of the WAF instance. Valid values:

<props="china">- version_3: Premium Edition in the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="china">- version_4: Business Edition in the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="china">- version_5: Ultimate Edition in the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="china">- version_exclusive_cluster: virtual exclusive cluster edition in the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="china">- version_hybrid_cloud_standard: Hybrid Cloud WAF Edition in the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="china">- version_pro_asia: Premium Edition outside the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="china">- version_business_asia: Business Edition outside the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="china">- version_enterprise_asia: Ultimate Edition outside the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="china">- version_exclusive_cluster_asia: virtual exclusive cluster edition outside the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="china">- version_hybrid_cloud_standard_asia: Hybrid Cloud WAF Edition outside the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="china">- version_elastic_bill: pay-as-you-go billing method edition.</props>
<props="china">- version_elastic_bill_new: pay-as-you-go billing method 2.0 edition.</props>

<props="china">If the returned version parameter value is not in the preceding list, confirm that you are using an Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com) account.</props>

<props="intl">- version_business_china: Business Edition in the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="intl">- version_enterprise_china: Ultimate Edition in the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="intl">- version_exclusive_china: virtual exclusive cluster edition in the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="intl">- version_hybrid_cloud_standard_china: Hybrid Cloud WAF Edition in the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="intl">- version_pro: Premium Edition outside the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="intl">- version_business: Business Edition outside the Chinese mainland.</props>
<props="intl">- version_enterprise: Ultimate Edition outside the Chinese mainland.</props>

<props="intl">- version_hybrid_cloud_standard: Hybrid Cloud WAF Edition outside the Chinese mainland.</props>

<props="intl">If the returned version parameter value is not in the preceding list, confirm that you are using an Alibaba Cloud International Website (www.alibabacloud.com) account.</props>

This parameter is not returned if PayType is 0 (WAF instance is not activated)
